title: Ice Cream Truck (Baby Boo)
blurb: The ice cream truck jingle — the sound that has commanded children to run since the invention of the freezer. Its tinny, slightly-off melody is universally recognised and mildly ominous when heard at the wrong hour. Play it to trigger childhood Pavlovian responses in adults, or to announce that the treats have arrived.
origin: The classic ice cream truck jingle, viral as a nostalgia trigger.
